model_update_rule: Prequential rolling refit at each decision using only completed bars then available; later observations within a test fold may update later predictions but never earlier ones.
purge_and_embargo: One full UTC day between declared initial-training end and test start, exceeding the one-bar label overlap.
qualification_evidence_requirements: canonical fold model or deterministic no-fit declaration hashes
per-fold target and return artifact paths and SHA-256 values
stitched out-of-fold return artifact path and SHA-256
exact registration, strategy, source-bundle, risk, config, and snapshot hashes
stitching_rule: Organizer concatenates only canonical test predictions in fold order; warmup before fold-1 is never scored.
